clue.text: The brave man confined to bed will get a cigar

parts.note: a cot is a small bed

explanation.surface: A heroic invalid stuck in bed is rewarded with a smoke.
explanation.definitionFit: A cheroot is a type of cigar with both ends cut square.

clue.text: Show an animal outside without cover

parts.note: a cat is an animal

explanation.surface: An animal exposed to the elements outside.
explanation.definitionFit: A cabaret is a floor show of songs and sketches at a nightclub.

clue.text: Hannibal's trumpeters

explanation.surface: The buglers in an ancient general's army.
explanation.definitionFit: Hannibal took war beasts with trunks over the Alps, and those creatures trumpet.

clue.text: A letter carried by some gaol-bird

explanation.surface: A prisoner carrying a message in jail.
explanation.definitionFit: Omega is the last letter of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: A printer's error that's come to light

indicators.note: an error suggests the letters of a printer's have been set wrongly, rearranged

parts.note: the possessive adds no letter, giving the word printers

explanation.definitionFit: To transpire is to become known or emerge, as a hidden fact does.

clue.text: Give a talking-to, being direct

to mark a letter or remarks for a particular recipient

explanation.surface: Telling someone off by being blunt with them.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is speaking formally to a gathering; the other is aiming a letter or remark at someone.

clue.text: Help to keep in credit — sharp!

parts.note: aid means help

clue.text: He opposes people in the old-fashioned retrogressive way

parts.note: ye is an archaic spelling of the, as in 'ye olde'

explanation.definitionFit: A foe is someone who stands against you.

clue.text: Trains the first mate, note

clue.text: A tip Robin Hood put to good use

parts.words: A tip Robin Hood put to good use

clue.text: Prepared to play

parts.note: reads as ready to start a game, but means having practised a stage piece before performance

explanation.surface: Ready for the game to begin.

clue.text: Bet or back like a king

parts.note: to lay a sum is to wager it
taken as written

clue.text: Invigorating drink

definitions.meaning: as an adjective, restoring vigour or energy
the quinine-flavoured mixer often served with gin

clue.text: Scientific device becomes more impenetrable under study

clue.text: Not even a partisan

clue.text: Lies inert — not normally bouncy

clue.text: "— is young ambition's ladder." (J. Caesar)

explanation.walkthrough: The missing first word of Brutus's line in Julius Caesar, Act 2, is the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Brutus means that humility is the ladder up which ambitious young men climb before scorning its lower rungs.

clue.text: They raise no objection when a fool comes in

parts.note: an ass is a foolish person

clue.text: Obliging with a strongly musical story

clue.text: Go back for the right issue

parts.note: egress means an issue, a going out or exit

clue.text: Lie about strength of character

clue.text: Battle cry grips the regiment

clue.text: Bizarre route-quite bizarre
